home_intro: This is your personal space to track, understand, and manage PCOS with the support of family and doctors.
assessment_subtitle: Answer honestly — this takes about 2 minutes and helps us give you a useful screening indicator. This is not a medical diagnosis.
disclaimer_text: This tool provides a self-assessment screening indicator only, based on commonly reported PCOS symptoms. It is NOT a medical diagnosis. A confirmed PCOS diagnosis requires clinical evaluation by a gynecologist, including blood hormone tests and a pelvic ultrasound.

remedy_1: Place a warm compress or hot water bag on your lower abdomen for 15–20 minutes.
remedy_2: Sip warm water, ginger tea, or chamomile tea slowly through the day.
remedy_3: Try gentle stretching or a slow walk — light movement often eases cramps.
remedy_4: Rest when you need to; there's no need to push through the pain.
reach_out_title: Want your people to know you need extra care today?
chatbot_subtitle: A caring AI companion to talk to — about your day, symptoms, cravings, or anything on your mind. Not a doctor, just a friendly ear.
games_subtitle: A few minutes of play can genuinely ease stress and take your mind off cramps. Pick one below.
game1_desc: A calm 3D bubble world — pop floating bubbles at your own pace.
game2_desc: A fast 3D lane-runner — dodge stress clouds, collect self-care hearts.
game3_desc: A flipping 3D memory card game with a self-care twist.
game4_desc: Answer a few playful questions and let us guess what you're in the mood for.
yoga_subtitle: Gentle, doctor-friendly movement to support hormone balance, weight, and stress. Follow along, or start a guided session.
yoga_disclaimer: Yoga and exercise can help manage PCOS symptoms such as weight, insulin resistance and stress, but they do not cure PCOS. Please check with your doctor first, especially if you are pregnant, have pain, or any medical condition.
poster_2: PCOS is part of your story, not all of it.
poster_3: Small steps every day add up.
yoga_butterfly_desc: Sit, join the soles of your feet, and gently flap your knees. Eases pelvic tension.
yoga_cobra_desc: Lie on your belly, lift your chest with palms down. Stretches the abdomen and boosts circulation.
yoga_child_desc: Kneel, sit back on heels, fold forward with arms stretched. Calms the mind and relieves cramps.
yoga_bridge_desc: Lie on your back, knees bent, lift your hips. Strengthens the back and pelvic area.
yoga_catcow_desc: On hands and knees, arch and round your spine with your breath. Loosens the spine and lower back.
yoga_breathing_desc: Breathe in through one nostril, out through the other, slowly. Reduces stress and anxiety.
